interfaces: ReviewSubmissionRequest { taskId, role, revisionIdentity, reviewerId, runId, contextPackage, outcome, details, findings, evidenceRefs, nonPass?, occurredAt }
ReviewFinding { findingId, severity, observed, expected, requirementRef?, contractRef?, evidenceRef?, remediation? }
ReviewSubmissionResult { reviewId, taskId, role, outcome, revisionIdentity, contextPackageId, blockingFindings, evidenceLineageId, evidenceSequence, recordedAt, evidenceLocation }

behavioralConstraints: submit() rejects a request missing a schema-valid taskId, recognized role, recognized outcome, non-empty trimmed revisionIdentity, reviewerId, or runId as INVALID_REQUEST before any evidence lookup or persistence occurs
submit() rejects a contextPackage whose taskId, role, or sourceRevision does not exactly match the request as CONTEXT_PACKAGE_MISMATCH
for any role other than Developer, submit() requires a CURRENT Developer review-result record for the same taskId; a missing record is DEVELOPER_HANDOFF_MISSING
for any role other than Developer, a Developer record bound to a different revisionIdentity than the current submission is DEVELOPER_HANDOFF_REVISION_MISMATCH
for any role other than Developer, a Developer record whose outcome is not PASS is DEVELOPER_HANDOFF_NOT_PASSED
for any role other than Developer, a Developer record whose reviewerId equals the current submission's reviewerId is SELF_APPROVAL_REJECTED regardless of role
a submission with outcome PASS and at least one finding at MEDIUM, HIGH, or CRITICAL severity is rejected as PASS_WITH_BLOCKING_FINDINGS
a submission with outcome FAIL or BLOCKED and no nonPass reason/remediation is rejected as NON_PASS_MISSING_DETAIL

every accepted submission is persisted as an ipt.review-result record (schemaVersion 1.1.0) through the unmodified BOOT-015 evidence store, keyed by reviewResultLineageId(taskId, role), carrying the submission's reviewerId and the computed contextPackageId

submit() reads the just-persisted record back through checkRevision and only returns success once it is confirmed CURRENT for the exact revisionIdentity submitted; any other status is EVIDENCE_REJECTED
repeated submissions for the same taskId/role each create a new sequence-numbered record; no prior record is ever overwritten, and getHistory exposes every earlier record as SUPERSEDED
invariants: the framework decides no role-specific QA/Architecture/UAT/Product judgment; it only binds, validates, and persists an already-decided outcome and findings
the framework invokes no agent provider and performs no network access
the framework computes no merge readiness and mutates no lifecycle state
MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL blocking-severity policy is enforced once here, not redefined per role workflow
the already-versioned ipt.review-result 1.0.0 schema shape is only ever extended with new optional fields, never narrowed or redefined
examples: a Developer submits role=Developer outcome=PASS with an implementation handoff; a different reviewerId then submits role=QA outcome=PASS referencing the same revision and contextPackage bound to role=QA, and both are persisted as separate CURRENT records under their own role lineage
a QA submission with outcome=FAIL and one HIGH-severity finding plus a nonPass reason/remediation is accepted and recorded with that finding reported in blockingFindings
a second QA submission for the same task after rework creates evidence sequence 2 under the same lineage; sequence 1 becomes SUPERSEDED but remains readable through getHistory
edgeCases: an Architect submission before any Developer handoff exists is rejected as DEVELOPER_HANDOFF_MISSING
a QA submission whose contextPackage was compiled for a since-superseded revision is rejected as CONTEXT_PACKAGE_MISMATCH even though the taskId and role match
the same reviewerId used for both the Developer handoff and a later QA submission for that same revision is rejected as SELF_APPROVAL_REJECTED even though the two submissions occur far apart in time
a PASS submission whose only findings are INFO/LOW severity is accepted; PASS_WITH_BLOCKING_FINDINGS only triggers at MEDIUM severity and above
an evidence-store schema rejection (a malformed details shape for the declared role) surfaces as EVIDENCE_REJECTED rather than being silently accepted

expectations: role-specific review workflows (BOOT-018 QA, BOOT-019 Architect, BOOT-020 UAT/Product) compute their own outcome/findings/details and call submit() rather than re-implementing revision binding, blocking-finding classification, or self-approval prevention
a role workflow can trust that a PASS result returned by submit() never carries an unresolved blocking finding
acceptedRanges: a ReviewSubmissionResult with outcome PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED
a structured ReviewFrameworkError with a stable code for any rejected submission
requiredReachableRanges: a successful PASS submission with no blocking findings
a successful FAIL/BLOCKED submission with a blocking finding and nonPass detail
rejection before a Developer handoff exists or passes
rejection of a same-actor self-approval attempt

expectations: BOOT-021 can read every prior review-result attempt for a task/role lineage, not only the current one, to decide which approvals remain valid after a revision changes
acceptedRanges: an ordered getHistory() sequence of ipt.review-result records for one task/role lineage
requiredReachableRanges: a lineage with a single CURRENT record
a lineage with one or more SUPERSEDED records preceding the CURRENT one
